title: refactor(Development/AutomorphicArithmetic/AutomorphicVarieties/ModularityArgument/ThresholdArguments/DenseThresholdCases): delegate TCentChar to HermitianTwists.CentChar
body:
Delegate `UpperTheory.V.Sd.Wc.centChar_alt` in `DenseThresholdCases/TCentChar.lean` directly to `UpperTheory.V.Af.Rn.centChar` from `HermitianTwists/CentChar.lean` instead of duplicating the central-character proof, and remove the unused private imports.

Removes the private `UpperTheory.V.Sd.Wc.CentralCharacter` helpers (`orb`, `orb_comm`, `orb_act`, `annPart`, `exists_type`, `sc`, `corner_scalar`, `sc_comm`, `continuous_sc`, `cptPart`, `cpt_fin`, `schur`, `inf_sc`, `fin_sc`, `commute_rt`, `lie_sc_rt`, `lie_sc_act`, `Scal`, `Scal.mul`, `scal_fin`, `scal_sign`, `scal_exp`, `decomp`, `scal_all`, `continuous_pInf`, `main`) from `TCentChar.lean`.
